title: Ducts serving Type II hoods.
officialText:
Single or combined Type II exhaust systems for food-processing operations shall be independent of
all other exhaust systems. Commercial kitchen exhaust systems serving Type II hoods shall comply with Sections 506.4.1 and 506.4.2.
